decision: Engine API over docker exec CLI
why: CLI never exposes exec id so resize is impossible; API is what docker exec calls

decision: platform WS upgrade + global loopback middleware
why: NodeHttpServer registers upgrade handling; HttpServerRequest.upgrade yields Socket

phase: unit1-3: SandboxShell{output,write,resize} on Sandboxes; Docker impl = Engine API exec over unix socket (TTY bash -l, cwd /workspace, TERM=xterm-256color). Verified live: echo, resize 100x40->90x30, Ctrl-C SIGINT, exit ends stream. Teardown finding: closing hijacked socket does NOT kill the exec'd process (docker keeps it); fix = shell records container PID at /tmp/.pi-shell-pid, finalizer writes 'exit', polls /exec/id/json 1.5s, then HUPs the pgrp via a second exec. Test in docker.docker.test.ts passed.
unit4: local Sandboxes.shell = python3 pty.spawn(bash -l) (macOS script needs a real tty stdin; python pty.spawn tolerates pipes). resize is a no-op locally (PTY unreachable). Smoke-verified.

unit5-7: Seat.shell (SandboxUnavailable when no sandbox) + Seat.sandboxChanges via watchDoc(SandboxDoc) (drop-first; later emissions end session). Conversations.seat is read-only, never resumes. WS route /api/conversations/:id/shell: query cols/rows, binary frames=PTY both ways, text frame resize, {type:closed,reason} + CloseEvent(1000) before close; loopbackOnly guards the upgrade (same router). apiUrl on /api/info via apiLayer({apiUrl}) — browser must WS-connect direct (Next rewrite cant proxy WS).

unit8: 6 route tests pass vs local pty.spawn backend: non-loopback Origin 403 (global middleware covers upgrade), 404 missing/paused, echo+exit-closed, resize frame tolerated, pause->closed{sandbox}, upgrade->closed{sandbox}+reconnect works. WebSocket client in tests = NodeWS (ws pkg).
